CustomField.description: Optional JSON Excel styling (CSV has none) for every sheet of this export. Keys: header, body, alternateRows, columns (by field path or header label), conditionalFormatting, headerHeight, freezeHeader, autoFilter, showGridLines, tabColor. Cell styles use ExcelJS's style format (font, fill, border, alignment, numFmt). See the Data Export page of the component library.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: JSON styling in ExcelJS format, e.g. {"header": {"fill": {"type": "pattern", "pattern": "solid", "fgColor": {"argb": "FF032D60"}}}}
CustomField.label: Styles
